state:
**Goal `ext-intl` — Stage 2 is on disk: ADR 0277 fixes the `Novis\Intl` API and `wit/intl.wit` is its interface.** Nothing of the component itself exists yet: no `extensions/intl/`, no embedding, no Novis half.

ADR 0277 is the API's one record and the goal's one slot; it is taken, and no session opens another number. § 1 is the class table (eight job classes in Novis source over the manifest class `Novis\Intl\Icu`), § 9 the thirteen exports of `nvs:intl/icu`, and `rule:core-classes/intl-roster`, `intl-batch-shape`, `intl-locale-is-an-argument` and `intl-host-converts-time` are its fragments, all `designed`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ext_world.rs` holds the interface: the Stage 2 check's two tests are written there. Stage 8 in `data/goals/ext-intl.json` carries one `proofs --verify --group` check per class, `Icu` included.

Three things 0277 leaves to the session that pins ICU4X, each written there as *not checked*: whether `icu_collator` writes sort keys itself (§ 3), which locale set `compiled_data` bakes in (§ 10), and which `Core\Time` accessors give a `DateTime`'s offset (§ 6). The record's choices that differ from the goal prose: there is no `Instant`-plus-`Zone` member (`dateTimes` takes `DateTime`s), and `RelativeTime::format` takes a count and a unit, not a `Duration`.

next.title: collation, and the component is built in

items.text: **The crate and its embedding** — `rule:packaging/the-first-party-components-are-built-in`: `extensions/intl/` outside the workspace, ICU4X pinned (`icu_experimental` with `=`), built for `wasm32-wasip2` by the image's build script at `crates/nvs-ext/build.rs:116`, embedded beside `IMAGE` at `crates/nvs-ext/src/builtin.rs:18` with its digest folded in at `crates/nvs-ext/src/builtin.rs:99`. The manifest's one class is `Novis\Intl\Icu` with every § 9 export (the unimplemented ones return `runtime`, as the image's did), its enums named as ADR 0277 § 1 names them.

**Collation** — `rule:core-classes/intl-batch-shape`, ADR 0277 § 3: `collate-order` and `sort-keys` (`wit/intl.wit:190`) over `icu_collator`, dispatched beside the image's at `crates/nvs-ext/src/builtin.rs:35`, `Collator::sort` and `sortKeys` in `extensions/intl/nvs/`, and the locale handling of `rule:core-classes/intl-locale-is-an-argument` (malformed tag, fallback, the `-u-ks/kf/kn` clash) in `extensions/intl/src/lib.rs`, shared by every later export. The Stage 3 tests in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs` and the three `tests/conformance/novis/intl-*.nvst` cases.

backlog: Stage 4: numbers and plural rules (ADR 0277 § 4–5); the agreement test reads `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/cldr.rs:1625`.
Stage 5: dates, relative time, lists (ADR 0277 § 6); the Novis half converts a `DateTime` with `Core\Time`.
Stage 0's two sentences: `rule:packaging/the-first-party-components-are-built-in`'s **Not on disk** and the `cldr.rs` module doc, rewritten when the behaviour lands.
